section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Radio, Stereo Tape Player and Antenna
title: BAD SOUND QUALITY

content.text: (a) Sound quality bad when radio played.

items: Tuner dial not synchronized with station
Vibration sound from components near speaker

content.description: Flowchart for Test 1 troubleshooting bad sound quality in certain areas. Starts with checking if sound quality is bad in certain areas only, then branches to check if tuner dial is properly synchronized. Includes decision points and actions for temporary antenna installation, inspection, and synchronization procedures.
labels: Is sound quality bad in certain areas only?
FM multipath interference and excessively strong AM reception near broadcasting station cannot be avoided in most cases.
Inspect antenna, cable and booster, and repair as necessary

content.description: Flowchart for Test 2 troubleshooting speaker installation and vibration issues. Starts with checking if speaker is installed correctly, branches to check for vibration sound from components near speaker, then leads to actions including proper installation, repair, temporary speaker installation, or radio replacement.
labels: Is speaker installed correctly (not loose or too tight)?
Is there a vibration sound coming from components near speaker?
Properly install. If speaker frame bent, replace.

content.text: NOTE: FM distortion tends to increase sharply if the tuner is not synchronized.
